sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [F]O little town of [Gbdim]Bethlehem,
[Gm/Bb]How [Dm/A]still we see [Gm/Bb]thee [C7/Bb]lie!
[F]Above [Am]thy [Dm/A]deep and dreamless sleep
[Gm/Bb]The [Dm/A]silent stars [F/C]go [C7/Bb]by.
[F/C]Yet in [Am]thy [Gm/Bb]dark [Bdim]streets [Dbm]shineth
[Am]The [Dm]everlasting [Gbm/Db]Light;
[F/C]The hopes [Am]and [Fm]fears [F]of [Gbdim]all [Gm]the years
[Bb]Are met [Am]in [F]thee tonight.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [F]For Christ is born of Mary, and gathered [Gm]all above,
[F]While mortals [Am]sleep, the [Dm/A]angels keep their watch of [Gm/D]wondering [Dm]love.
[Am]O morning [Dm]stars together, [F]proclaim [Gm/D]the holy [Gbm/Db]birth,
[Bb]And praises sing [Am]to God [F]the King, and peace to men on earth!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [F]How silently, how silently, the [Gbdim]wondrous [Gm]Gift is giv'n;
[F]So God imparts [Am]to human [Dm]hearts the blessings [Gm/D]of His [Dm]heav'n.
[Am]No ear may [Dm]hear His [Edim]coming, [F]but in [Gm/D]this world [Gbm/Db]of sin,
[Bb]Where meek souls will [Am]receive [F]Him still, the dear Christ enters in.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [F]O holy Child of Bethlehem, descend [Gbdim]to [Gm]us, we pray;
[F]Cast out our sin, [Am]and enter [Dm]in, be born in [Gm/D]us today.
[Am]We hear the [Dm]Christmas [Edim]angels [F]the great [Gm/D]glad tidings [Gbm/Db]tell;
[Bb]O come to us, [Am]abide [F]with us, our Lord Emmanuel!
